ownership: Public facility-level records assembled by EPA from federal and state environmental program systems through FRS and ECHO
source_access: Public anonymous read-only HTTPS download published as the weekly ECHO Exporter.
allowed_use: redistribution of approved facility-level normalized fields with EPA attribution and semantic limitations
prohibited_use: representing FAC_ACTIVE_FLAG as proof that a business is generally operating, open to the public, or active in every associated environmental program
representing ECHO facilities as all U.S. businesses
representing RCRA active or inactive designations as independently carrying legal or regulatory significance
presenting ZIP- or county-centroid coordinates as premise-level geocodes
inferring a legal organization, owner, or parent company from FAC_NAME
merging facilities across sources without versioned evidence
attribution: Source: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Enforcement and Compliance History Online (ECHO) Exporter and Facility Registry Service identifiers.
retention: Indefinite for immutable source and approved normalized records unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Approved normalized public facility records may be redistributed with EPA attribution, source timestamp, archive checksum, provenance, active-status definition, coordinate precision, and coverage limitations retained; the compressed source archive remains internal.
